image_title: Comparison of Scores in AIME, AMC, and MATH
summary: This bar chart compares scores across three categories: AIME, AMC, and MATH. For AIME, the scores are as follows: TTRL at 15.8, T3RL (1.5B Verifier) at 20.8, and T3RL (7B Verifier) at 21.7. In the AMC category, TTRL scored 48.9, while T3RL (1.5B Verifier) achieved 50.9, and T3RL (7B Verifier) reached 51.5. Lastly, for MATH, TTRL scored 73.0, T3RL (1.5B Verifier) at 74.6, and T3RL (7B Verifier) at 74.9. The chart illustrates a trend of increasing scores from TTRL to T3RL across all categories.
